title: Cinematic scene
summary: Bring an imagined place to life with cinematic motion.
description: Build an atmospheric scene from a description or a reference image. Set the location, light, camera movement and ambient sound, and put them together into one continuous moment.
brief: Make a cinematic scene: {{location}}, {{time and weather}}. The camera {{camera move}} and comes to rest on {{closing detail}}.

fields.label: location
fields.hint: The place you want to put viewers in

fields.label: time and weather
fields.hint: When it is and what the weather is like; this sets the overall mood
fields.example: a rainy evening as the streetlights come on

fields.label: camera move
fields.hint: Where the camera starts and where it goes
fields.example: slowly pushes in from the lighthouse toward the street corner

fields.label: closing detail
fields.hint: The one image people should remember at the end
fields.example: a bakery with its lights still on

beats: Come to rest on a detail
